summary: Enhance your leadership and management skills with our comprehensive business training course. Empower your career and drive organizational success today.
lede: Leadership and management in business connects strategic goals with the people and processes that deliver them. This course is for managers, department heads, project leads and technical team leads responsible for team outcomes. It develops practical skills in translating strategy into team objectives, coaching performance and planning change, helping professionals guide day-to-day execution.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who hold formal responsibility for team outputs and organizational performance across diverse sectors.
modules: Leadership and Management in Business Foundations
Strategic Alignment and the Balanced Scorecard
Situational Leadership II and Performance Coaching
High-Performance Team Dynamics and Psychological Safety
Data-Driven Decision Making and AI Integration
prerequisites: Participants should currently hold a management or supervisory role, or be identified for transition into such a role within the next six months. A basic understanding of their organization's strategic goals and operational structure is required. No specific software proficiency is needed, though familiarity with standard office productivity tools is recommended for the digital exercise components.
